title: Dual GPU Rendering Pipeline: High-Performance Vulkan & Fallback OpenGL
summary: Telos now features dual graphics backends with automatic GPU vendor scoring, bindless Vulkan 1.3 descriptors, and robust OpenGL 4.5 compatibility.
author: Telos Core Team
content: To deliver blistering frame rates on modern hardware while maintaining 100% compatibility across older hardware, Telos provides a dual rendering pipeline. The primary Vulkan 1.3 engine leverages buffer device addresses (BDA), bindless texture arrays, and asynchronous compute queues, reaching over 240 FPS on dedicated GPUs. Meanwhile, our integrated OpenGL 4.5 renderer ensures seamless cross-platform fallback for integrated graphics and virtual environments.
